=> < cloudA | UserX : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > .

[B3] < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , deviceA : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ deviceA 'bind' cloudA | (Key)
=> < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , deviceA : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < deviceA | 'exists' : true , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > < deviceA | 'exists' : true , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
